correctness.rationale: For n=3k+r, r=1,2 and k>=0, m=n+3 is automatically coprime to n. Independent symbolic summation over all three exact h(j)=floor((3j+2)/m) intervals reproduces the four polynomials a,b,c,d of Q=a(1+s^6)+b(s+s^5)+c(s^2+s^4)+d s^3. Recomputing the Joukowski cubic R(u)=au^3+bu^2+(c-3a)u+d-2b gives precisely both displayed factored negative discriminants, R(-2)>0 and R(2)=m^3>0 for every integer k>=0; hence R has one real simple root below -2 and a nonreal simple conjugate pair. Their reciprocal s preimages are six distinct simple roots, exactly three nonzero interior, with the asserted negative-real/conjugate types. Independent symbolic limits give R/k^3 -> (u+1)^2(u+4)/2 and R(-1+v/k)/k -> 3v^2/2+3, so u_nonreal=-1±i sqrt(2)/k+o(1/k), u_real->-4. Holomorphic inverse of s+s^{-1} at the primitive cube roots yields s_±=ζ_±(1-sqrt(2/3)/k+o(1/k)), and n times radial deficit -> sqrt(6); the stable real root tends to -2+sqrt(3). Endpoint k=0 allowed and checked; all roots nonzero because a>0. Positive-n denominator on oblique slice is nonzero per primary formula. Independent exact symbolic derivation (not just source log) and finite numeric values checked; no claim about all off-diagonal kernel zeros.

originality.rationale: Qualified best-of-knowledge: Edholm–Mathew supplied the exact general polynomial and published gap-one/two root behavior; their Section 4.3 explicitly says gap-three unit-circle nonvanishing was already proved, so neither nonvanishing nor the mere number of three interior zeros is a new claim. MathDB independently repeats that qualitative coverage without exposing a proof. The submitted contribution beyond it is a precise simple-root type classification and, chiefly, universal first-order radial coefficient sqrt(6) for the complex pair in both residue progressions; this requires nontrivial cubic discriminant factorization and singular double-root scaling, not stated by the materially inspected antecedent. No separate published result with the same first-order limit was found. The unlinked authors' gap-three proof remains a material priority risk.

value.rationale: For a natural degenerating sequence of distinct rational Hartogs domains m/n=1+3/n, this identifies exactly which of the three diagonal zero levels remain inside and which migrate to the unit circle, with their precise rate sqrt(6)/n. The invariant concerns an analytically meaningful zero slice, not an arbitrary numerical sample; it sharpens known gap-three zero counts to a quantitative boundary-condensation law relevant to stability of Lu Qi-Keng behavior under domain degeneration. It is a bounded exact classification, not a claim of full kernel zero geometry or a new general theory.
